blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

West End is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 319 homes sold there: 314 condos and 5 townhomes. 314 condos sold in West End with a median price of $770,000 (the middle half sold between $555,900 and $1,183,750), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 9% sold above list.
West End home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

314 condos sold in West End with a median price of $770,000 (the middle half sold between $555,900 and $1,183,750), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $956 per square foot, a median year built of 1989 and a median strata fee of $666 a month. 5 townhomes sold in West End with a median price of $1,055,000, taking a median of 8 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $1,018 per square foot, a median year built of 2001 and a median strata fee of $651 a month.

faq.q: What did condos in West End sell for?
faq.a: 314 condos sold in West End between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $770,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in West End?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.8% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in West End sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 314 condos that sold in West End went for between $555,900 and $1,183,750, around a median of $770,000.

faq.q: Do condos in West End sell above asking price?
faq.a: 9% of the 314 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.8% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in West End?
faq.a: Of the 314 sales, 311 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $666.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in West End?
faq.a: The median year built was 1989 for the 314 condos sold in West End.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in West End usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in West End had 2 bedrooms, from the 314 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Vancouver?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
